title: Foundations & TPS
description: Lean vs Six Sigma, Toyota Production System, the 3Ms, Kaizen and PDCA, JIT, Jidoka, Heijunka, Andon.
examFocus: The syllabus names TPS, Mura and the aims of Six Sigma as low-scoring themes in the class quizzes.

title: Lean principles & waste
description: Five Lean principles, value-added work, the wastes (TIMWOODS), Gemba / waste walk.
note: The slide shows 7 wastes, the syllabus 8 (it adds unused talent). Questions follow the syllabus and say so.

title: Belts, DMAIC & charter
description: Belt roles, Champion, DMAIC phases and tollgates, project charter, SMART, RACI.
examFocus: The Champion role is a low-scoring theme in the class quizzes.

title: Define: VOC, CTQ & SIPOC
description: Voice of the Customer / Business, CTQ, SIPOC, stakeholders and scope.
examFocus: SIPOC and VOC are low-scoring themes in the class quizzes.

title: Process mapping & VSM
description: Flowcharts, swimlanes, value stream mapping, process cycle efficiency.

title: Measure: time, flow & capacity
description: Takt time, cycle time, lead time, Little's Law, utilization, bottlenecks, First Time Right.
examFocus: Takt time is a low-scoring theme in the class quizzes.

title: Measure: defects & sigma
description: Defects and opportunities, DPU, DPO, DPMO, yield, rolled throughput yield, sigma level.

title: Analyze: root causes
description: Root cause analysis, 5 Whys, Ishikawa, Pareto, A3, FMEA.
examFocus: 5 Whys is a low-scoring theme in the class quizzes.

title: Analyze: data & variation
description: Descriptive statistics, common vs special causes, control charts, Cp/Cpk.
note: Syllabus only. No lecture slide covers this, so it may go beyond the exam.

title: Improve: flow, pull & error-proofing
description: One-piece flow, pull and Kanban, Heijunka, line balancing, Poka Yoke, Jidoka.
examFocus: Poka Yoke examples are a low-scoring theme in the class quizzes.

title: Improve: 5S, SMED & standard work
description: 5S, visual management, standardized work, SMED, daily huddles.

title: TPM, OEE & constraints
description: Total Productive Maintenance, OEE, six big losses, Theory of Constraints.

title: Control & Lean leadership
description: Control plan, Lean leadership, Hoshin Kanri, DMAIC vs PDCA.

title: Integrated case: the university helpdesk
description: The syllabus case from Define to Control, with the numbers: success rates, FTR, DPMO, flow time and absolute against relative reduction.

title: Agile & Scrum basics
description: What Agile is, waterfall against Scrum, the Agile Manifesto, where Agile comes from, how Scrum differs from Lean, ITIL and DevOps.
note: From Scrum lecture 1 and the lecture 5 and 6 decks.
examFocus: The exam is multiple choice and combines Lean and Scrum (lecture 1, slide 5).

title: Scrum: theory, values & roles
description: Empiricism, the three pillars, the five values, the Scrum Team, Product Owner, Scrum Master and Developers.
note: Scrum lectures 2 to 4 are not in the folder. This comes from the Scrum Guide 2020 (the homework of lecture 1) and the Scrum Kahoot.
examFocus: The Scrum Kahoot asks about the roles and the three pillars.

title: Scrum: the five events
description: The Sprint, Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review and Sprint Retrospective, with their time-boxes.
note: Scrum lectures 2 to 4 are not in the folder. This comes from the Scrum Guide 2020 (the homework of lecture 1) and the Scrum Kahoot.
examFocus: The Scrum Kahoot asks about the Sprint time-box, the Daily Scrum and the Retrospective.

title: Scrum: artifacts & commitments
description: Product Backlog and Product Goal, Sprint Backlog and Sprint Goal, Increment and Definition of Done.
note: Scrum lectures 2 to 4 are not in the folder. This comes from the Scrum Guide 2020 (the homework of lecture 1) and the Scrum Kahoot.
examFocus: The Scrum Kahoot asks about the Product Backlog and the Definition of Done.

title: ITIL 4
description: Service Value System, guiding principles, the service value chain, four dimensions, practice groups.
note: The slides list names and numbers only. The explanations come from the Scrum Kahoot and from public ITIL 4 Foundation material (marked "outside the course files").
examFocus: The Scrum Kahoot asks six ITIL questions.

title: Kanban & DevOps
description: Kanban principles and practices, WIP limits, flow, DevOps goal, culture, CI/CD, monitoring, shift-left.
note: Obeya board has no usable content (title only). The Kanban practices beyond the Kahoot come from the public Kanban Method.
examFocus: The Scrum Kahoot asks 6 Kanban and 6 DevOps questions.
